scope: all 31 active scientific repositories: current README identity/status plus typed vertical, horizontal, provenance, shared-substrate, operational and ecosystem relations
display_rule: one active scientific repository = one visible fragment; repository existence alone does not create a scientific fragment; connection type never transfers evidence ownership

tracking.movement: Live public GitHub repository metadata. pushed_at marks repository motion, not scientific revision.
tracking.scientific_ref_detail: Repositories are audited on the default branch unless an explicit scientific_ref is declared. BALANCE currently uses active PR #2 because the reader-facing middle-world formulation and six-proposition result set are on analysis/middle-world-v1. SCH PR #1 has merged and SCH is audited on main.
tracking.claim_drift: README drift is an audit signal, not an automatic scientific reinterpretation.

status_semantics.result: the current scientific core is closed; negative, mixed and conditional results count
status_semantics.bounded: a repository-owned result exists with explicit external, empirical or transfer limits
status_semantics.open: a prospectively frozen or explicitly staged scientific gate remains unresolved
status_semantics.stop: retired or superseded; not an active fragment
status_semantics.staging: repository exists but does not yet own an independent scientific question/inferential contract; this is not a scientific status
